capabilities: Manage projects, tasks and notes as Markdown files from a dashboard view
Store files per project and in a shared General project
Save credentials encrypted with AES-GCM and a master password
Browse a monthly calendar with recurring calendar-event notes
Run custom JavaScript from note-defined toolbar buttons
disambiguation: Not a developer debugging tool; despite the DevHelper name it is a project and task dashboard.
extras: UI and website docs are in Spanish only. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Code execution for toolbar buttons is off by default and shell commands only run on desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard for managing projects, tasks, project files and dates together from one view over plain notes.

relations.evidence: Bases (Bases/*.base) seeded on first run so the same data is browsable with Obsidian Bases
ten SKILL.md files (Spanish) that teach AI agents (Claude Code, OpenCode…) the plugin's data model

summary: Project and task dashboard backed by Markdown notes, with per-project files, encrypted credentials and a monthly calendar of recurring events.
